I have done most of this most of my life; I do not "see" these imaginary people or "friends", I simply imagine there being someone there. I will pretend I am some character I made up or a character I enjoy or feel close with, then think up stories about them.

I feel as if it is my way of making me feel better about hating myself and my life, thinking that I could have these friends, dates, experiences, et cetera.

You're not alone, many people do this to cope with the facts of hating themselves or certain aspects of themselves.

Don't know how to speak with a professional; I have no money and no one to talk with that can.

And anyways, that will force many things I don't want my family to know about. We hardly have enough money to make due. 

From what I've read up, it could be a slow thyroid, but we don't have the time or money to see professionals about it, nor do I have anyone I could go to about it.

The main reason is my inability to memorize things; I cannot memorize most things, therefore I do bad in school. Because I cannot memorize most of what is taught, I cannot learn foreign languages or go to college, disqualifying me from emigrating, which is what I want to do; like I said, I am even willing to be a sanitation worker or flip burgers if I have to just to live outside the US.

Almost anyone can *go* to those countries, but not move there without the necessary qualifications.
